properties.description: This Use Case is designed to detect events when External dynamic lists configured on Palo Alto firewalls (for action=block or deny) are triggered
properties.query:
let TriggeredIPs =
SecurityAlert
| where DisplayName contains"GO-PRD-SENTINEL-042 MSFS EDL feed hits"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| extend A = parse_json(Entities)
| mvexpand A
| extend IP = tostring(A.Address)
| where isnotempty(IP)
| summarize make_list(IP);
//
let ceflogs = CommonSecurityLog1
| where TimeGenerated > ago (10m)
| where DeviceCustomString1 in( "EDL-Malicious" , "sec_go_msfs_ip_block" , "sec_go_msfs_knet_ip_block_in" , "sec_go_msfs_knet_ip_block_out", "sec_go_msfs_inet_ip_block_out", "sec_go_pa_malicious_block_out", "sec_go_pa_high-risk_block_out")
| where SourceIP !in (TriggeredIPs);

let palogs = paloaltologs
| where TimeGenerated > ago (10m)
| where Activity == "TRAFFIC"
| where RuleName in( "EDL-Malicious" , "sec_go_msfs_ip_block" , "sec_go_msfs_knet_ip_block_in" , "sec_go_msfs_knet_ip_block_out", "sec_go_msfs_inet_ip_block_out", "sec_go_pa_malicious_block_out", "sec_go_pa_high-risk_block_out")
| where SourceIP !in (TriggeredIPs);

ceflogs | union palogs
| extend AccountCustomEntity = SourceUserName
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP
| extend URLCustomEntity = RequestURL;
